notes: The certified canvass. Every statewide figure on the Board's results pages is looked for in it; a question's totals are read from it, and so are those of a contest the Board prints only county by county.

The Clerk's results website, headed 'Official Contest Results', current as of Tuesday, November 19, 2024 02:10 PM: each contest's figures for the whole county. Cities, villages, townships, and park, library, fire and school boards (all but Chicago's Board of Education) elect their officers at the consolidated election in April of odd years, so they are not on this ballot; only their questions are.

The Board's 'Download Data in Excel' file for this contest, from its results page for the election (the canvassed results; the statewide questions' figures are checked against the State Board's post-canvass files precinct by precinct).

The Clerk's precinct canvass, on its Precinct Canvasses page: the official canvass of suburban Cook County (the City of Chicago votes with its own Board). This election's file gives each township's totals, not precincts. Cities, villages, townships, and park, library, fire and school boards (all but Chicago's Board of Education) elect their officers at the consolidated election in April of odd years, so they are not on this ballot; only their questions are.

The Clerk's summary of the official results of both election authorities in Cook County, from its Election Results Archive: each contest's Cook County column, City of Chicago column and Combined Total. Used as the control for every contest either authority carries.

The Clerk's results site (linked from https://dupageco.org/elections/election_results.php), report time 11/26/2024 9:25:15 AM CST: every precinct's votes by vote type. Its figures are checked against the Clerk's Official Canvass. Cities, villages, townships, and park, library, fire and school boards (all but Chicago's Board of Education) elect their officers at the consolidated election in April of odd years, so they are not on this ballot; only their questions are.
The County Clerk's certified canvass, linked from https://dupageco.org/elections/election_results.php.

The Clerk's results site (linked from https://www.lakecountyil.gov/320/Election-Results-Archive-Nov-2008---Pres), report time 11/22/2024 3:02:00 PM CST: every precinct's votes by vote type. The site's page is headed 'Official Results' (site updated 11/22/2024 3:03:09 PM CST); the statewide questions' figures are checked against the State Board's post-canvass files. gaps: county
Declared write-in votes, precinct by precinct

In 9 counties (Carroll County, Cass County, Kane County, Knox County, McLean County, Morgan County, St. Clair County, Tazewell County, Winnebago County) the State Board's precinct files and its County pages disagree on a declared write-in candidate's votes (a file leaves them out, counts them under another spelling, or carries votes the County page does not count). The county figures stored are the County pages', which add up to the statewide totals; the precinct rows are the files' as printed. Every difference is listed in this election's checks.
https://www.elections.il.gov/electionoperations/ElectionVoteTotalsCounty.aspx?ID=9huvqbsiUWA%3D
race
"Should the Illinois Constitution be amended to create an additional 3% tax on income greater than $1,000,000 for the purpose of dedicating funds raised to property tax relief?"

The State Board's certified Official Canvass prints this question's totals as yes 3,296,951 and no 2,126,060, but its own results pages, its County pages and the counties' precinct files all add up to yes 3,288,462 and no 2,121,507, and some of the canvass's county lines for this question differ from the County pages. The totals stored are the canvass's and the counties' figures are the County pages', so the store's check reports the difference; nothing was changed to hide it.
https://www.elections.il.gov/Downloads/ElectionOperations/VoteTotals/2024GEOfficialVote.pdf

The State Board's certified Official Canvass prints this question's totals as yes 3,951,890 and no 1,510,294, but its own results pages, its County pages and the counties' precinct files all add up to yes 3,914,126 and no 1,474,158, and some of the canvass's county lines for this question differ from the County pages. The totals stored are the canvass's and the counties' figures are the County pages', so the store's check reports the difference; nothing was changed to hide it.
